data.name: HEAVY Sword
data.detailed_description:
HEAVY Sword

Get ready to GET HEAVY!

HEAVY Sword is a comedic, 3D action-adventure platformer with RPG elements, heavily inspired by the golden era of 3D gaming classics like Super Mario 64, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, and a bit of Donkey Kong Country 2.

The Story: A Tale of Two "Heroes"

Pike Fireblood knows he is a hero. He’s got a burning desire for ultimate glory. So when Professor Blunk calls him to the lab to save the world from the Goblin King’s new weapon—the HEFTY Sword—Pike is ready to claim his destiny!

There's just one tiny catch. The HEAVY Sword corrupts the mind of any man who wields it. The only creature immune to its dark energy? A Grizzlob. Specifically, Pike’s lazy, breakfast-lovin' pal, Grind.

While Grind’s magical laziness makes him the only one who can swing the ultimate weapon without losing his mind (he just gets a little sleepy), Pike is stuck with the most important job of all: being a glorified waiter and food-runner for a napping Sloth-Bear. Together, this chaotic duo must journey to the Eastern Mountains to stop the Goblin King before it's too late!

Key Features

  • An Epic (and Exhausting) Quest: Explore a vibrant 3D world filled with monsters born from the rotted seeds of the Omni Tree.

  • Classic 3D Platforming: Leap, slash, and explore your way through levels inspired by the mechanics and charm of 90s console masterpieces.

  • The Power of the Naps: Harness the absorbing power of the HEAVY Sword—just make sure your wielder gets enough snacks to keep fighting!

  • Dynamic 2-Player Co-op: Team up with a friend! Work together to balance Grind’s heavy-hitting combat prowess and Pike’s frantic support skills.

  • Light RPG Elements: Power up your duo, defeat iconic foes, and collect the resources needed to keep your quest moving forward!

data.short_description: Heavy Sword is an action-adventure 3D platformer with some RPG elements. Pike and Grind must quest to stop the Goblin King from forging an unstoppable blade that would bring about the end of the realm.
